title: ID0453790-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002205] Power Converters Issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Power Converters Issue
Solution:
After following the error flag,
we can see that there are missing converters in DC1.
There are three possible solutions:
First, check the Connector If it is Attached Correctly, move to the next step.​​​​​​​
Check the Fast Shutdown cable connecting to the converter. If the cable is also fine, continue.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it, just to confirm whether the problem is the Fast Shutdown cable or to the converter.
If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
After following the error flag,
We can consider that the level of the cooling liquid (Glysofor) is at the warning stage, so following the error we should first visually check the level of the liquid, and if it is low, make sure to top up and make sure to use the glasses and the gloves.
I will send you the reference for the correct type of liquid required for this charger:
8EM5905-0AA00-0AA2 – Cooling Liquid Glysofor N 52%
If not the case, and the level of the liquid is OK, we should check the XD9.1B and XD9.1A.
If they are OK, we should check the voltage between XD37:18C and XD37:2C . If it gives us 24V, it means we should change the tank.

additional_info.subject: Issue description
additional_info.body:
can you please have a look at the charger 170002205?
We see 2 error flags there regarding power converters.
- PowerConverter[13] PLC DEVICE true
2102312VGQKXNB000094SA002200000200FW:DC116PF000H100,F:0
false
- PowerConverters PLC DEVICE true Missing Converters in DC1 false
Those errors are not self-recoverable. We sent a remote hard reset,
and it did not resolve the issue.
Thank you very much for your analysis

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453790-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002205] Power Converters Issue CRM:03042000014
additional_info.body:
Dear
Meghna
,
After an on-site visit on Tuesday, October 7th, I have these findings
Converter 2102312VGQKXNB000094SA002200000200FW after a complete power cycle started working properly.
We tested a charging session with this converter in the group, and it reached the desired voltage with other converters in the group working in parallel.
Regarding the cooling unit, the problem was only in the low level of coolant. After adding the coolant error flag disapeared.
Therefore charger is in operative state with no shortcomings.
Thank you for your support.
Kind regards,
Milan
